description:
Give issue rejection one command form.

## Background

An issue can be rejected through a dedicated reject command, which accepts a reason and records it as a `resolution:` label, or through a state update to `rejected`, which accepts no reason. Two forms of one transition invite inconsistent records and force agents to remember which form takes which flag.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Exactly one command form rejects an issue, and it accepts an optional reason recorded the same way in every case.
- [hard] REQ-02: The removed form is gone from the CLI, schema, MCP tools and documentation.
title: Give issue rejection one command form
